siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.description: The HTTP or HTTPS base URL of a Discourse site.

categoryPath.title: Category
categoryPath.description: The category slug path and numeric ID, or blank for all topics.

loader.url: {% assign base = scope.params.siteUrl | regex_replace: '/+$', '' %}{{ base }}{% if scope.params.categoryPath != '' %}/c/{{ scope.params.categoryPath }}/l{% endif %}/{% if scope.params.feed == 'new' %}latest{% else %}{{ scope.params.feed }}{% endif %}.json{% if scope.params.feed == 'new' %}?order=created{% endif %}

timestamp.template: {% if scope.params.feed == 'new' %}{{ scope.item.created_at | date_to_ms }}{% else %}{{ scope.item.bumped_at | date_to_ms }}{% endif %}

icon.template: {% assign user = scope.response.json.users | where: 'username', scope.item.last_poster_username | first %}{% if user and user.avatar_template %}{{ user.avatar_template | replace: '{size}', '48' | absolute_url: scope.params.siteUrl }}{% endif %}
